components.name: Gantt
components.description: Gantt chart: GanttTasks as bars on a shared date axis, in the order given. Each bar is a click target.
examples:
plan = Gantt([design, build, review, launch], "Q4 rollout")
design = GanttTask("Design", "2026-11-02", "2026-11-13", 100, "Ada")
build = GanttTask("Build", "2026-11-09", "2026-12-04", 45, "Grace")
review = GanttTask("Security review", "2026-12-01", "2026-12-11", 0, "Linus")
launch = GanttTask("Launch", "2026-12-14")

components.name: GanttTask
components.signature: GanttTask(name: string, start: string, end?: string, progress?: number, owner?: string)
components.description: One bar in a Gantt. start and end are "YYYY-MM-DD" (end inclusive; omit or "" for a one-day milestone). progress is 0-100; owner is a short label.
